|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Motti (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “[Pilot] 2. Once per game, may ▼ Kuat Drive Yards. Kuat DriveYards is [Immune to Alter]. Unique (•) Star Destroyers are power +2 (+5 if armed with a starship weapon).”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Unique (•) Star Destroyers are power +2 (+5 if armed with a starship weapon). Kuat Drive Yards is immune to Alter. Once per game, may deploy Kuat Drive Yards from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' “[Pilot] 2. Once per game, may ▼ Kuat Drive Yards. Kuat DriveYards is [Immune” → “Adds 2”; “Alter].” → “power of anything he pilots.”; added “Kuat Drive Yards is immune to Alter. Once per game, may deploy Kuat Drive Yards from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 40. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Motti]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Motti (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Motti]]. Code OVS3 · GEMP id 1103_40.
